main.description: The author claims control of a website, domain, or handle on another service. A verifier places attest-proof:<record cid> where only the controller could and issues a monster.attest.verification. Record key: a base32 sha256 of the subject/target, so there is one per author per subject.

target.description: https://<origin>/ for a website, dns:<domain>, github:<user>, bsky:<handle>, or another service:<handle> pair.

signatures.description: Inline signatures per the ATProtocol Attestation Specification; attest requires one from the author's device key (did:key, delegated from their passkey).
